title: TDD contract (tdd-workflow)
description: App-specific facts the TDD checkers read from contracts/tdd.json (or the file rn-skills.config.json names under tddContract). Every key is optional; a missing key takes the default for the canonical layout (each workspace's src/ when package.json has workspaces).

logicGlobs.description: Folders whose .ts modules with a runtime export need a test (check-tests, rule untested-module). Replaces the default list.

sourceGlobs.description: Production code for the history rules (check-test-edits, rule code-without-test): .ts and .tsx files matching one of these globs, minus tests, testing/, fixtures/, __mocks__/ and .d.ts files.

ignore.description: Extra repo-relative globs both checkers skip (installed skills, node_modules and generated native folders are always skipped).

requirementIdPattern.description: A regular expression matching the app's requirement IDs (for example \bTASKS-\d+\b). When set, every new test file of a feat or fix commit quotes one (requirement-not-quoted) and every Spec-Change trailer cites one (spec-change-reason). null for an app without requirement IDs: a Spec-Change trailer then still names some reference (TASKS-12, #41, issue 41, spec 4.2), the commit-msg default. Use the same pattern as contracts/commits.json requirementRef.pattern when the app sets both.
